name: Custom Shadow Mapping for Satellite Imagery
definition: A shadow mapping technique that casts geometrically consistent shadows by comparing elevation renders from a satellite camera and a sun camera, avoiding ray marching which is incompatible with Gaussian Splatting.
summary: Custom Shadow Mapping for Satellite Imagery casts geometrically consistent shadows in 3D Gaussian Splatting by comparing elevation renders from satellite and sun cameras, avoiding ray marching.
